about: This repo's own ADRs under docs/adr, checked against its own history. Labels by the session reading each diff (docs/spikes/2026-11-07-dogfood.md, runs 1 and 3). No CONFLICT rows yet: a lint-and-reformat commit whose author knew the ADRs. Tests the false-alarm side only.

cases.quote: Modules under `src/adrcheck/domain/` import only the standard library and each other.
The boundary is enforced by `tests/test_boundaries.py`, which fails on the first offending import.
No code path reports a CONFLICT that skipped `verify()`.
Only CONFLICT can make `adrcheck check` exit non-zero under `--fail-on conflict`.
